customer_request: Prepare a disconnected demonstration of a maintenance-work-order flow.
stated_outcome: Give technicians a traceable offline workflow without affecting equipment control.
facts: The laboratory is physically separate from operational technology.
The site safety lead controls access and all equipment-related decisions.
The demonstration uses generated assets and maintenance events.
visible_tensions: A site contact suggests connecting briefly to an unlisted switch for convenience.
The planned session would leave one learner working alone after normal hours.
known_boundaries: No connection to operational technology or undeclared networks.
Unsafe lone work, fatigue or missing emergency communication triggers stop-work.
learner_note: This is the learner-visible baseline. An assessor may add a controlled changed constraint during an observed exercise.
